name: TR-FactBench
description: TR-FactBench is a Turkish resource for four-way source-grounded factuality verification (supported, partially supported, contradicted, unverifiable) in the finance, legal, and medical domains. It contains 4,800 training examples with construction-time labels, a 960-example general development set and a 600-example stress development set with one blind human review pass, and Gold-480, a held-out set of 120 source contexts with four claims each, labeled independently by two annotators (Cohen's kappa 0.867) and adjudicated. The release also includes the frozen held-out predictions of an ELECTRA-TR LoRA encoder and eight prompted LLM conditions, the paired context-group bootstrap, and the code for training, evaluation, and all reported analyses. Licenses: code is released under the MIT license; project-created questions, claims, labels, and metadata are released under CC BY 4.0; context passages remain subject to the terms of their sources.
